6.31 rsInvalidBackgroundImagePosition
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidBackgroundImagePosition is a critical error that will occur when a BackgroundImage.Position
element is not set to one of its valid values.
